description: Applies a booking sync Sergio held back for returning far fewer bookings than it holds, once, and makes that size the new normal, as Accept this smaller sync on Data sources does. job_id is the held sync's import job. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.
